title: ptilostemon muticus
intro: Ptilostemon muticus, commonly known as Rockrose or Red-stemmed Rockrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Ptilostemon muticus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
